decision_for_lead: The batch door does not apply IFC_LIMITS.active (2 queued or running), which stays on POST .../ifc: the dispatcher runs one IFC worker at a time and queued jobs wait, while a refusal would leave the third IFC of a batch unread with no automatic retry. The per-source history limit is not checked either: the batch queues at most one job per item and source revision.
